paragraphs.en: Diffusion and autoregression (AR) have long been seen as different categories of generative models, with diffusion specialising in continuous fields and AR specialising in discrete tokens. Recent work seeks to combine the advantages of the two models, and each hybrid fixes its decoding schedule by design. In this paper, we ask whether the performance of decoding schedules of one model can be predicted before decoding at a fixed number of steps. We describe diffusion, AR, and models in between as paths on one corruption lattice, and define the cost of a schedule as the dependence its parallel steps discard. The cost shows that the fewest steps of a zero-cost schedule are set by the geometry of the data, in the same way for tokens and for continuous fields. In particular, for data that are Markov on a graph and dependent along its paths, the fewest steps equal the graph’s treedepth, which is logarithmic in the length of a sequence and linear in the side length of a grid. With fewer steps than the treedepth, every schedule pays a positive cost, whose ranking we predict before decoding with a kernel of pairwise dependence estimated from pretrained weights. Across text generation, image generation, and video generation, we verify most of the predictions about the rankings of different schedules under different metrics and benchmarks. This work therefore provides a design principle for decoding for future AR models, diffusion models, and anything in between. Our code is available at https://github.com/TSUITUENYUE/The-Lattice-of-Transition-Laws.

paragraphs.en: Autoregression, the default method for discrete tokens, generates each coordinate conditioned on what is already revealed ( van den Oord et al., 2016 ) . Diffusion, the default for continuous fields, progressively removes noise from all coordinates together ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Song et al., 2021 ) . Recent work combines their advantages in both domains. For continuous fields, coordinate-by-coordinate generation conditions each coordinate on the content generated before it ( Li et al., 2024 ) and lets a video grow to any length ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . For discrete tokens, parallel updates reduce the one step per token required by autoregression ( Nie et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 自回归是离散标记的默认方法，它在生成每个坐标时都以已揭示的内容为条件（van den Oord 等人，2016）。 扩散模型是连续场的默认方法，它能逐步从所有坐标中同时移除噪声（Ho 等人，2020；Song 等人，2021）。 近期的研究将这两种方法在各自领域的优势结合了起来。 对于连续场，逐坐标生成方法将每个坐标的生成条件建立在之前生成的内容之上（Li 等人，2024），并允许视频扩展至任意长度（Chen 等人，2024；Chen 等人，2025）。 对于离散标记，并行更新减少了自回归所需的每标记一步的生成时间（Nie 等人，2025）。

paragraphs.en: In existing hybrid models, the design of each model fixes how autoregression and diffusion are combined ( Arriola et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026a ; Sahoo et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2023 ; Ruhe et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2024 ) . However, their measured quality reports only the schedule each model fixes. The schedule matters: with the same weights and the same few-step budget, the image quality of MAR varies by an order of magnitude across reveal orders (Table 3 ). Yet we lack a design principle that decides the schedule for a given model and data. A candidate schedule can only be judged after decoding with it. We therefore ask whether the performance of the decoding schedules of one model can be predicted before decoding.
paragraphs.zh: 在现有的混合模型中，每个模型的设计都固定了自回归和扩散的结合方式（Arriola 等人，2025；Liu 等人，2026a；Sahoo 等人，2026；Wu 等人，2023；Ruhe 等人，2024；Kim 等人，2024）。 然而，它们所测量的质量报告仅说明了每个模型固定的调度方案。 调度方案至关重要：在权重和少数步预算相同的情况下，MAR 的图像质量因揭示顺序的不同而相差一个数量级（表 3）。 但我们目前缺乏一种设计原则，能够针对给定的模型和数据决定其调度方案。 候选调度方案只有在用它进行解码之后才能被评估。 因此，我们想知道：是否可以在解码之前预测某一模型解码调度方案的性能。

paragraphs.en: Such a principle first needs a space that contains every schedule it can choose from and compare against. We assign a corruption level to each coordinate and let the levels vary independently, so that some coordinates can be clean while others are partly or fully corrupted. These assignments form the corruption lattice L d L^{d} . A decoding schedule then decides a path through the lattice: at each step, it chooses which coordinates to update and by how much (Figure 1 ).

paragraphs.en: A unifying space alone is not sufficient to be a design principle. Ranking different schedules needs a quantified cost. Earlier work also unifies the two families on discrete tokens: the training objective of masked diffusion is that of an any-order autoregressive model ( Ou et al., 2025 ) , and a per-position noise schedule on tokens expresses autoregression as a special case of diffusion ( Fathi et al., 2025 ) . Our lattice holds continuous fields as well, where Diffusion Forcing trains video with an independent noise level per frame, as next-token prediction with uncertainty ( Chen et al., 2024 ) . These prior works describe schedules, while our lattice adds a cost that compares them before decoding and predicts their performance. On our lattice, every step has an exact joint law for the coordinates it updates, and the cost of a parallel step is the dependence lost when each of them is drawn from its own conditional, which adds up along the path to the schedule’s divergence from exact sampling (Section 3 ). For data that are Markov on a graph and dependent along its paths, the ideal zero-cost schedule follows an elimination tree of the graph, updating the coordinates at one depth of the tree per step. The least depth of such a tree, the treedepth, is a lower bound on the number of steps of any zero-cost schedule (Section 4 ).

paragraphs.en: Proposition 1 holds on every monotone path of the lattice, for continuous values and interior levels as well as for tokens, and the identity of Chen et al. (2026) is its special case on the two-level absorbing lattice with every advanced set fixed. The two also answer different questions. Averaged over positions drawn at random, their identity depends only on how many tokens each step unmasks, through the mean information that a token shares with a random set of revealed tokens, and their schedules choose these step widths. Proposition 1 keeps the positions and levels of a given path and asks which coordinates each step should update. Two schedules with the same widths can differ widely in this cost, since neighbouring coordinates share more information than distant ones. paragraphs.en: Given the revealed coordinates, coordinates in different connected components of G G are independent, and a step that resolves one coordinate per component has zero cost (Appendix C ). Two coordinates of one component are dependent, and a zero-cost step resolves at most one of them. Resolving a coordinate removes it from G G and can split its component. Hence a zero-cost schedule traces an elimination tree of G G , in which each resolved coordinate is the parent of the components it leaves and each step resolves one depth. The least depth of such a tree is the treedepth ( Nešetřil and Ossona de Mendez, 2006 ) . On a chain of d d coordinates, the midpoint rule resolves the midpoint of every run, which halves every run, and finishes in ⌈ log 2 ⁡ ( d + 1 ) ⌉ \lceil\log_{2}(d+1)\rceil steps, the chain’s treedepth. On an n × n n\times n grid, splitting the grid takes a whole row or column, and the treedepth lies between n + 1 n+1 and a constant multiple of n n ( Nešetřil and Ossona de Mendez, 2012 ; Bodlaender, 1998 ; George, 1973 ) .

paragraphs.en: We rank the selection rules by their pairwise estimates, computed from the model’s kernel using Lemma 2 . On the sequence, contiguous selection groups the pairs with the largest kernel values. Confidence selection favours coordinates already determined by local context, which usually lie close together, and its estimate is large as well. Random selection mixes near and distant pairs and has an intermediate estimate. The spread rule and the separator rule keep selected pairs farther apart and have the smallest estimates. On the grid, raster order has the largest estimate, then the random and midpoint rules, and the spread, nested and low-discrepancy rules the smallest.
paragraphs.zh: 我们根据模型核通过引理 2 计算出的成对估计值，对选择规则进行排序。 在序列上，连续选择会将具有最大核值的成对组合在一起。 置信度选择倾向于由局部上下文已确定的坐标，这些坐标通常彼此接近，且其估计值也很大。 随机选择会将邻近和遥远的成对组合混合，并具有中等大小的估计值。 扩散规则和分隔规则会使所选成对保持更远的距离，且它们的估计值最小。 在网格上，光栅顺序的估计值最大，其次是随机和中点规则，而扩散、嵌套和低差异规则的估计值最小。

paragraphs.en: On MAR, FID follows the predicted ordering of the raster, random, midpoint and spread rules at 8 and 16 steps, random and midpoint tie at 32, and the low-discrepancy rule, which the estimates place above spread, reads lowest (Figure 5 b, Table 3 ). Randomly selecting that many tokens places many pairs at distances where the kernel is still large, and smaller selections place fewer. At 64 steps, every order except raster lies within 0.1 FID of the others, as their estimates predict.
paragraphs.zh: 在 MAR 中，FID 遵循栅格、随机、中点以及扩散规则在 8 步和 16 步时的预测排序；在 32 步时，随机规则与中点规则并列；而低差异规则的得分最低（估计值将其置于扩散规则之上），如图 5b 和表 3 所示。 扩散规则的增益在 8 步时最大，此时它将 FID 相较于模型自身的随机排序降低了超过 25%。 此后每一步平均推进 256 个标记中的 32 个，最多可达 49 个。 随机选择如此多的标记会使许多标记对处于核函数仍较大的距离上，而选择较少的标记则会使这种情况减少。 在 64 步时，除栅格排序外的所有排序与其他排序的 FID 差异都在 0.1 以内，这与它们的估计值预测一致。

paragraphs.en: We use LLaDA to test rankings under generative perplexity and task accuracy. Confidence selection chooses tokens by the model’s output, which a position-only rule ignores. The kernel predicts a gain from keeping the model’s confidence ranking while excluding strongly dependent pairs, which the min-distance rule and the separator constraint do. Relative to plain confidence, the min-distance rule lowers perplexity at every measured budget, also once repetition is controlled (Appendix C.9 ), and both constraints improve GSM8K accuracy from 8 to 32 steps (Table 4 ). The GSM8K gain is largest at 8 and 16 steps, where steps are widest, and disappears from 64 steps on.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 LLaDA 测试生成困惑度和任务准确率下的排名。 置信度选择依据模型输出挑选词元，而仅基于位置的规则会忽略这一点。 该核函数预测了保留模型置信度排名同时排除强依赖词对所带来的增益，而最小距离规则和分隔符约束都能实现这一点。 与单纯的置信度方法相比，最小距离规则在所有测得的预算下都降低了困惑度，在控制重复性后也是如此（附录 C.9）；此外，这两种约束都将 GSM8K 的准确率从 8 步提升至 32 步（表 4）。 GSM8K 的增益在 8 步和 16 步时最大，此时步数间隔最宽；而从 64 步开始则消失。

paragraphs.en: The cost also predicts a trend, which we verify with the above experiments: the fewer the steps, the larger the gain over the released models’ own rules, in FID and GSM8K accuracy (Tables 3 and 4 ).

paragraphs.en: To see whether the estimate also gives the size of the cost, and how the cost compares with errors in the trained conditionals, we measure it on text8 as the excess bpc of a decode over the schedule’s own sequential chain (Table 5 ). The estimate is at or below this excess at every budget and ranks the rules in the same order, including the spread–separator tie at 2 steps. At 2 steps it is about 30% to 50% of the excess; the absolute gap narrows with more steps.
paragraphs.zh: 为了判断该估计值是否也能给出成本的大小，以及该成本与训练条件概率中的误差相比如何，我们在 text8 上将其测量为解码相对于计划自身序列链的超额 bpc（表 5）。 在每个预算下，该估计值都等于或低于这一超额值，并且以相同的顺序对规则进行排序，包括第 2 步时 spread–separator 的平局情况。 在第 2 步时，它大约占超额值的 30% 到 50%；随着步骤增加，绝对差距会缩小。

paragraphs.en: A schedule’s total bpc (Table 3 ) minus its excess is the bpc of its sequential chain, and differences between chains are conditional errors, since text entropy is independent of order. The left-to-right chain has the lowest bpc, but contiguous selection pays the largest dependence cost, and spread a lower one with higher conditional error. When steps are wide, their difference in dependence cost is several times their difference in conditional error. paragraphs.en: A common observation in diffusion language models is that the absorbing channel works best ( Austin et al., 2021 ; Lou et al., 2024 ; Sahoo et al., 2024 ) , and the cost defined on the lattice gives one explanation consistent with it. An interior level, such as a token under uniform noise or a revealed character class, lowers the dependence cost of each set, since the other coordinates’ interior values carry part of the dependence, but adds an advance to every coordinate, which widens every step at a fixed budget (Section 3 ); it helps when the saving exceeds the cost of the wider steps. We measure this trade-off with a graded text8 model whose interior level reveals whether a character is a space, a vowel or a consonant. Before decoding, the pairwise estimates of its two stages sum to 2 times the absorbing model’s at 8 steps, where the wider steps win, and to within a few thousandths of it from 16, where the two about cancel. The absorbing model’s bpc is lower at every budget (Table 6 ), at 8 steps mostly through the larger dependence cost and from 16 steps mostly through the graded model’s own sequential chain (Appendix C.7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在扩散语言模型中，一个常见的观察结果是吸收通道效果最佳（Austin et al., 2021；Lou et al., 2024；Sahoo et al., 2024），而定义在晶格上的成本提供了一个与此一致的解释。 内部层级（例如均匀噪声下的一个词元或一个已揭示的字符类别）会降低每个集合的依赖成本，因为其他坐标的内部值承载了部分依赖关系，但也会为每个坐标增加一个推进项，从而在固定预算下扩大每一步（第3节）；当节省的成本超过更宽步骤所增加的成本时，这种层级会有所帮助。 我们使用一个分级文本8模型来衡量这种权衡，该模型的内部层级可以揭示某个字符是空格、元音还是辅音。 在解码之前，其两个阶段的成对估计值之和在8步时等于吸收模型在相同步数下估计值的2倍，此时更宽的步骤占优；而在16步时，两者之差仅为千分之几，几乎相互抵消。 吸收模型的bpc在所有预算水平下都更低（表6）：在8步时，这主要归因于更大的依赖成本；从16步开始，则主要由于分级模型自身的序列链所致（附录C.7）。

paragraphs.en: In this paper we ask whether the performance of the decoding schedules of one model can be predicted before decoding, and build a space and a cost that a design principle for choosing a schedule needs. The corruption lattice is a space that contains diffusion, autoregression and every schedule between them as paths through one family of transition laws. The dependence cost ranks these paths: it is the total correlation that a path’s parallel steps discard, and it equals the path’s divergence from exact sampling. When the data are Markov on a graph and dependent along its paths, the fewest steps of a zero-cost schedule equal the graph’s treedepth for tokens and continuous values alike, which is logarithmic in the length of a sequence but linear in the side length of a grid. With even fewer steps than the treedepth, a kernel of pairwise dependence estimated from pretrained weights predicts how schedules rank before decoding. Where schedules differ in dependence cost, most measured rankings follow the predicted ones across modalities and benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们探讨一个问题：是否可以在解码之前预测某一模型解码调度方案的性能？并构建一个空间与成本框架，作为选择调度方案的设计原则基础。 破坏晶格是一个包含扩散、自回归以及两者之间所有调度方案的空间，这些方案表现为通过一组转换定律的路径。 依赖成本对这些路径进行排序：它等于某条路径中并行步骤所丢弃的总相关性，也等于该路径与精确采样的偏离程度。 当数据在图上是马尔可夫结构且沿其路径存在依赖时，零成本调度方案所需的最少步骤数等于该图对标记和连续值共同的树深度——这一数值随序列长度呈对数增长，但随网格边长呈线性增长。 即使步骤数少于树深度，一个基于预训练权重估计出的成对依赖核也能在解码前预测各调度方案的排序关系。 当不同调度方案的依赖成本存在差异时，大多数实测排序结果在不同模态和基准测试中均与预测结果一致。

paragraphs.en: Order-agnostic autoregression and absorbing diffusion are special cases of autoregressive diffusion models, which support parallel generation adapted to a given budget of steps ( Hoogeboom et al., 2022 ) , and the training objective of absorbing diffusion is that of an any-order autoregressive model ( Ou et al., 2025 ) . Block diffusion generates autoregressively across blocks and uses diffusion within each block ( Arriola et al., 2025 ) . Draft-verify systems propose tokens with a diffusion head and accept them under an autoregressive model ( Liu et al., 2026a ) . Their deployed distribution remains autoregressive, with diffusion accelerating the proposals. Esoteric language models interpolate between the two objectives using a masking-rate hyperparameter ( Sahoo et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 顺序无关的自回归和吸收扩散是自回归扩散模型的特例，这些模型支持根据给定的步数预算进行并行生成（Hoogeboom 等人，2022），而吸收扩散的训练目标则是任意顺序自回归模型的目标（Ou 等人，2025）。 块扩散在块之间以自回归方式生成，并在每个块内部使用扩散方法（Arriola 等人，2025）。 草案-验证系统通过扩散头提出标记，并在自回归模型下接受这些标记（Liu 等人，2026a）。 其部署后的分布仍然是自回归的，而扩散则加速了草案的提出过程。 Esoteric 语言模型通过一个掩码率超参数在两种目标之间进行插值（Sahoo 等人，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Hyperschedules assign each token position a monotone noise schedule, with autoregression and diffusion as members of the resulting family ( Fathi et al., 2025 ) . Each schedule is a path on our lattice. The authors also study block and sliding-window schedules that advance from left to right on discrete text, obtaining each by fine-tuning a model trained with the diffusion schedule. AR-Diffusion assigns fewer denoising steps to tokens on the left, which therefore resolve first ( Wu et al., 2023 ) . Both works train under the likelihood bound of the chosen schedule. Both show that autoregression can be written as a diffusion schedule. Neither quantifies the dependence discarded when selected coordinates are sampled independently, so each schedule must be trained before it can be compared. paragraphs.en: Video models also use intermediate corruption levels. Diffusion Forcing trains with an independent level per coordinate on a causal architecture, motivated as uncertainty-aware next-token prediction ( Chen et al., 2024 ) . We represent these corruption patterns on a lattice and derive the dependence cost of each step, including steps over spatial coordinates. Rolling schedules and diagonal denoising fix the slope in advance ( Ruhe et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2024 ) ; streaming windows carry monotonically increasing levels ( Liu et al., 2026b ) . These arrangements are paths on the same lattice (Figure 1 ), whose per-step dependence cost Section 3 defines. For training across paths, we use two-stream attention from the order-modelling literature ( Yang et al., 2019 ) to recover the supervision density of autoregression.

paragraphs.en: On the absorbing lattice with every advanced set fixed, Proposition 1 is due to Chen et al. (2026) . They sharpen the parallel-decoding bound of Li and Cai (2025) to an identity: the divergence between the data and the finished sample is the sum over steps of the total correlation of the advanced coordinates conditioned on the revealed ones. Drawing the positions of each step uniformly among those still masked, they reduce the expected divergence to the distance between a curve of mean mutual information and its step approximation, choose how many coordinates each step advances, and derive O ⁡ ( log ⁡ d ) O(\log d) schedules for d d tokens in terms of the total and dual total correlation of the data. The averaging over positions removes the geometry that the kernel of Section 5 keeps: their O ⁡ ( log ⁡ d ) O(\log d) steps bound the error for data of small total or dual total correlation, and the treedepth of Theorem 1 counts the steps of exact sampling for data Markov on a graph and dependent along its paths, where the positions each step updates decide the cost. Proposition 1 extends the identity to every monotone path on the lattice, with coordinates at different levels, and to continuous channels. It gives the dependence cost of each schedule, allowing us to compare autoregressive and diffusion paths with block, sloped and confidence schedules on both tokens and continuous fields.

paragraphs.en: Luxembourg et al. (2026) study coordinate selection with a fixed number of steps per block. They unmask dilated groups of non-adjacent positions in parallel, minimise an upper bound on joint entropy gain, and outperform confidence planners on reasoning and code benchmarks at deployment scale. The selection pattern is fixed before decoding. Independence comes from distance: on a fast-mixing Markov chain, well-separated positions have a joint entropy within ε \varepsilon of the sum of their marginal entropies. Section 4 obtains exact independence from separation: when the data are Markov on a graph, revealed coordinates divide it into components, and selecting one coordinate per component gives zero total correlation at any state. The two mechanisms make different predictions on a grid, which Section 6.4 tests. Parallel Gibbs sampling updates the variables of one colour class of a Markov random field at once, since they are independent given all their neighbours ( Gonzalez et al., 2011 ) . A decoding step conditions only on the revealed coordinates, and its zero-cost sets are those separated by revealed coordinates. The fewest such steps are the treedepth of Theorem 1 , while a chain or a grid needs only 2 colours.

paragraphs.en: Confidence-based parallel decoding dates to MaskGIT ( Chang et al., 2022 ) . Subsequent work replaces confidence selection with supervised planners ( Asano et al., 2026 ) , learned policies ( Jazbec et al., 2026 ) , or lookahead over unmasking paths ( Lee et al., 2026 ) . These methods train a planner or require extra forward passes per step. The rules we compare require a sort or a position computation per step. Dilated selection uses a pattern fixed before decoding; Appendix C.10 times the other rules. Cai and Li (2026) prove acceleration for an entropy-capped rule that follows a uniformly random scan, unmasking until the sum of the batch’s conditional entropies crosses a threshold. Their theorem derives and controls equation 3 summed along the schedule as the exact cost of parallel unmasking. The averaging argument requires a random scan and does not cover the sorted rule used by deployed decoders. Moreover, the entropy cap uses the marginal entropies in equation 3 , while the cost also depends on the joint entropy of the selected coordinates. We measure the dependence cost of selecting coordinates by confidence in Appendix C (Tables 15 and 19 ).
paragraphs.zh: 基于置信度的并行解码可追溯至 MaskGIT（Chang 等人，2022）。 后续研究用监督规划器（Asano 等人，2026）、学习策略（Jazbec 等人，2026）或对未掩码路径的前瞻分析（Lee 等人，2026）取代了置信度选择方法。 这些方法需要训练一个规划器，或在每一步执行额外的前向传播。 我们所比较的规则在每一步都需要进行排序或位置计算。 膨胀选择使用在解码前固定的模式；附录 C.10 中的其他规则是其十倍。 Cai 和 Li（2026）证明了一种熵受限规则的加速效果：该规则遵循均匀随机扫描，持续掩码直到批次中条件熵之和超过一个阈值。 他们的定理推导并控制了沿调度序列求和的方程 3，将其作为并行掩码的精确成本。 平均论证需要随机扫描，且未涵盖部署解码器所使用的排序规则。 此外，熵限制使用了方程 3 中的边缘熵，而成本还取决于所选坐标的联合熵。 我们在附录 C（表 15 和表 19）中测量了基于置信度选择坐标的依赖成本。

paragraphs.en: Lemma 1 (Path representation). Let F F be the family of transition laws p ℓ → ℓ ′ p_{\ell\to\ell^{\prime}} between lattice points ℓ ′ ⪯ ℓ \ell^{\prime}\preceq\ell . Every monotone path composes elements of F F into a law whose marginal on the clean coordinates is the data distribution, and two paths differ only in which elements of F F they evaluate.
paragraphs.zh: 引理 1（路径表示）。 令 F F 为格点 ℓ ′ ⪯ ℓ \ell^{\prime}\preceq\ell 之间的转移律 p ℓ → ℓ ′ p_{\ell\to\ell^{\prime}} 的族。 每条单调路径都将 F F 中的元素组合成一个定律，该定律在干净坐标上的边缘分布即为数据分布，且两条路径仅在其评估的 F F 元素上有所不同。

sents.en: Lemma 1 (Path representation).
sents.zh: 引理 1（路径表示）。

sents.en: Let F F be the family of transition laws p ℓ → ℓ ′ p_{\ell\to\ell^{\prime}} between lattice points ℓ ′ ⪯ ℓ \ell^{\prime}\preceq\ell .
sents.zh: 令 F F 为格点 ℓ ′ ⪯ ℓ \ell^{\prime}\preceq\ell 之间的转移律 p ℓ → ℓ ′ p_{\ell\to\ell^{\prime}} 的族。

paragraphs.en: A monotone path visits states ℓ ( 0 ) = ⊤ ≻ ⋯ ≻ ℓ ( T ) = ⊥ \ell^{(0)}=\top\succ\dots\succ\ell^{(T)}=\bot . The joint law of the states along this path factorises into transition laws. The factor at step t t is by definition the transition law p ℓ ( t ) → ℓ ( t + 1 ) p_{\ell^{(t)}\to\ell^{(t+1)}} , an element of F F indexed by the source and destination lattice points. Composed from ⊤ \top , the factors run the corruption process in reverse. The marginal on the clean coordinates is the data law. When the corrupted state is a function of the data and the levels, the same composition is a factorisation of the data likelihood itself. Each factor depends on its two endpoint states. Two paths through the same lattice draw their factors from the same family. ∎
paragraphs.zh: 单调路径访问的状态为 ℓ ( 0 ) = ⊤ ≻ ⋯ ≻ ℓ ( T ) = ⊥ \ell^{(0)}=\top\succ\dots\succ\ell^{(T)}=\bot 。 该路径上各状态的联合分布可分解为转移定律。 第 t 步的因子按定义是转移定律 p ℓ ( t ) → ℓ ( t + 1 ) p_{\ell^{(t)}\to\ell^{(t+1)}}，即由源点和终点格点索引的 F 的一个元素。 这些因子由 ⊤ \top 组合而成，使腐蚀过程反向运行。 干净坐标上的边缘分布即为数据定律。 当被腐蚀的状态是数据和层级的函数时，相同的组合即构成数据似然本身的分解。 每个因子都依赖于其两个端点状态。 穿过同一格点的两条路径，其因子均源自同一个族。 ∎

paragraphs.en: The synchronised path gives a likelihood bound, and the sequential path the exact likelihood, which the AR-chain rows of Figure 2 evaluate and which continuous-time diffusion computes through its probability-flow ODE ( Song et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2018 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 同步路径给出了一个似然界，而序列路径则给出了精确的似然值；图2中的AR链行对这一精确似然值进行了评估，连续时间扩散模型则通过其概率流常微分方程（ODE）进行计算（Song et al., 2021; Chen et al., 2018）。

paragraphs.en: We define the corner quality gap at a corner as the difference in quality between a model trained on the whole lattice and one trained only for that corner.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将某个角点的质量差距定义为：在完整晶格上训练的模型与仅针对该角点训练的模型之间质量差异。

paragraphs.en: A model that realises F F realises the conditionals of every path. Any measured corner quality gap is attributable to finite capacity or optimisation, to the allocation of the training distribution over paths, or to which conditionals the architecture can supervise at a lattice point, and not to the coexistence of the two corners in one weight set.
paragraphs.zh: 一个实现 F F 的模型会实现每条路径的条件概率。 任何可测量的角点质量差异都源于有限的容量或优化、训练分布在各路径上的分配，或者架构在晶格点上能够监督哪些条件概率，而并非两个角点共存于同一权重集所致。

paragraphs.en: By Lemma 1 the conditionals of every path are elements of one family F F . A model that realises F F evaluates the conditionals of every path by restriction. A trained model departs from F F only through a model class that does not contain F F or training that does not reach it, through the probability its training distribution assigns to each path, or through an architecture that cannot supervise the conditionals at a lattice point. When these restrictions are absent, the realised conditionals coincide with F F at both corners. ∎

paragraphs.en: Figure 6 shows the pixel model’s intermediate states under 5 schedules. The synchronised path denoises the whole field at a common level, whereas a sloped path produces a visible noise gradient across the image at a given step. paragraphs.en: Figure 2 shows the first 2 pixel samples at a fixed seed and reads CIFAR-10 FID-50K with one evaluator. Its text8 models at 85M share data, budget and seed, and are teacher forced after 192 revealed characters. The lattice model’s training distribution splits every batch equally among prefix states, random-subset masking and intermediate widths, the last with a co-trained head that predicts the advanced coordinates jointly. Each model is read at its validation minimum: 25K training steps for the causal model, 165K for the dedicated masked model, 185K for the two-stream model and 510K for the lattice model. The dedicated masked model is clearly better at its minimum than at its last checkpoint, while the lattice and two-stream models read the same at both. The masked-ELBO rows average the chain over random orders, which the causal backbone cannot evaluate.

paragraphs.en: For the mixed model, replacing raster order with spread order lowers FID at slope 4 but raises it at slope 16 (Table 7 ). The dependence cost favours spread order at both slopes, since it keeps apart the patches that advance together. The held-out objective has been flat since 60K training steps, and continuing the model to 120K steps on fresh data changes it by less than 0.1%. With this doubled budget, the spread rule has lower FID than raster order at slope 16, over 10K samples and over 50K (Table 7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 对于混合模型，将栅格顺序替换为传播顺序可在坡度为 4 时降低 FID，但在坡度为 16 时则会提高 FID（表 7）。 依赖成本在两种坡度下都更倾向于传播顺序，因为它能保持同步推进的斑块彼此分离。 保留测试集的目标值自训练 60K 步以来一直保持稳定，将模型继续训练至 120K 步并使用新数据，其变化也小于 0.1%。 在预算翻倍的情况下，传播规则在坡度为 16 时的 FID 低于栅格顺序，无论是在超过 10K 个样本还是在超过 50K 个样本时都是如此（表 7）。

paragraphs.en: Condition on the revealed coordinates. The unresolved coordinates are Markov on G G , so coordinates in distinct connected components are independent given the revealed ones. A step that advances at most one coordinate per component advances a set of mutually independent coordinates, whose joint law is the product of its marginals, and its total correlation is zero. On a chain the unresolved coordinates form runs whose boundaries are revealed, and each run is one component. Resolving the midpoint of every run advances one coordinate per component, so the step costs zero, and it splits a run of length g g into two runs of length at most ⌊ g / 2 ⌋ \lfloor g/2\rfloor . A run of length d d is resolved after ⌈ log 2 ⁡ ( d + 1 ) ⌉ \lceil\log_{2}(d+1)\rceil such steps.
paragraphs.zh: 以已揭示的坐标为条件。 未解析的坐标在 G G 上是马尔可夫链，因此，在已知已揭示坐标的情况下，不同连通分量中的坐标相互独立。 每一步最多使每个分量中的一个坐标推进，从而推进一组相互独立的坐标；这些坐标的联合分布是其边缘分布的乘积，总相关性为零。 在一条链上，未解析的坐标会形成若干连续段，其边界已被揭示，且每个连续段构成一个分量。 解析每个连续段的中间点会使每个分量中的一个坐标推进，因此该步骤的成本为零，并且会将长度为 g g 的连续段分割成两个长度至多为 ⌊ g / 2 ⌋ \lfloor g/2\rfloor 的连续段。 一个长度为 d d 的连续段经过 ⌈ log 2 ⁡ ( d + 1 ) ⌉ \lceil\log_{2}(d+1)\rceil 次此类步骤后将被完全解析。

paragraphs.en: On MAR-B’s 16 × 16 16\times 16 token grid a rule chooses only the permutation that MAR reveals, in chunks set by its cosine schedule. The midpoint rule orders the tokens farthest point first: each next token is the one farthest in Chebyshev distance from those already revealed, with ties broken at random. The low-discrepancy rule takes the cells in the order a two-dimensional Halton sequence in bases 2 and 3 first reaches them. The nested rule takes the middle row and column first, then the middle row and column of each part they leave, as in nested dissection ( George, 1973 ) . The spread rule follows the bit-reversed Morton order, and spread then raster takes the first 64 tokens of the spread order and the rest row by row. MAR reveals a permutation from its end, and we reverse the midpoint, low-discrepancy, nested and spread-then-raster orders, which are built first-revealed-first, before MAR reads them.
paragraphs.zh: 在 MAR-B 的 16 × 16 令牌网格上，一条规则仅选择 MAR 所揭示的排列，其分块由余弦调度设定。 中点规则优先选择最远的令牌：每个后续令牌都是与已揭示令牌在切比雪夫距离上最远的那个，若出现距离相等则随机决定。 低差异规则按照二维 Halton 序列以底数 2 和 3 首次触及单元的顺序选取它们。 嵌套规则首先选取中间行和中间列，然后选取它们所覆盖各部分的中间行和中间列，如同嵌套剖分（George, 1973）。 扩散规则遵循比特反转的 Morton 顺序；而“扩散后逐行”规则则先取扩散顺序中的前 64 个令牌，其余部分则按行选取。 MAR 从末端揭示一个排列，而我们在 MAR 读取这些顺序之前，会将其反转——这些顺序是依据“先揭示者先处理”的原则构建的，包括中点、低差异、嵌套和扩散后逐行规则。

paragraphs.en: The kernel of Figure 4 b measures how far a masked token’s prediction moves when a revealed neighbour is perturbed. MAR-B’s diffusion head also gives each masked token’s law, and the Kullback–Leibler divergence between that law with and without one more revealed neighbour measures the information the neighbour carries. Before reading it, we registered that the floors built from the two kernels would order the rules alike, counting a reversal only where the displacement floors differ by more than 10%. The information kernel falls much faster with distance than the displacement kernel (Table 2 ). The two sets of floors order the rules alike at 8, 16, 32 and 64 steps, except low-discrepancy and nested, whose displacement floors lie within 3% of each other. Against the measured FIDs at 8 steps, both place nested well below random and spread below low-discrepancy, where the measurements put nested above random and low-discrepancy lowest. The information floor puts midpoint about 15% below random and the displacement floor about 7%, against a measured 18%.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the selection rules on the released language model using generative perplexity. At every budget, its kernel gives a larger pairwise estimate for the random rule than for the spread or midpoint rule; from 32 steps onward, the difference is only a few hundredths of a bit per token. The text8 ranking also predicts higher perplexity for confidence than for random, and a reduction when confidence selection is constrained to the minimum distance indicated by the kernel. At 8 and 16 steps, all these comparisons hold: the 95% bootstrap intervals for the corresponding log-perplexity differences exclude zero (Table 25 ). Min-distance has lower perplexity than plain confidence at every budget, and plain confidence has higher perplexity than random at every budget. At 32 steps, the intervals for all pairwise differences among the random, spread and midpoint rules include zero. At 64 steps the random rule’s perplexity is below the spread rule’s, with an interval that excludes zero, although its pairwise estimate is larger by a few hundredths of a bit per token.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用生成性困惑度，在已发布的语言模型上评估这些选择规则。 在每个预算水平下，其核函数对随机规则给出的成对估计值都高于扩散规则或中点规则；从第 32 步开始，这种差异仅为每个词元几百分之一比特。 text8 排名也预测，置信度规则的困惑度高于随机规则，而当置信度选择被限制在核函数指示的最小距离时，困惑度则会降低。 在第 8 步和第 16 步时，所有这些比较均成立：相应对数困惑度差异的 95% 自助区间均不包含零（表 25）。 在每个预算水平下，最小距离规则的困惑度都低于普通置信度规则，而普通置信度规则的困惑度又高于随机规则。 在第 32 步时，随机规则、扩散规则和中点规则之间所有成对差异的区间都包含零。 在第 64 步时，随机规则的困惑度低于扩散规则，且其区间不包含零，尽管其成对估计值仅高出几个百分之一比特/词元。

paragraphs.en: Repetition lowers generative perplexity, and the min-distance rule’s samples repeat more 4-token sequences than plain confidence’s at every budget (Table 25 ). paragraphs.en: We also compare schedules on released video weights using the kernel. A checkpoint from the Diffusion Forcing family supports an independent level per frame, allowing schedules to vary the memory depth: the number of earlier frames on which each segment conditions ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . Before decoding, we estimate the kernel between frames on these weights. It falls to about 60% of its value between adjacent frames within 6 latent frames and changes little beyond, whereas the token kernel in Figure 4 falls to near zero by distance 16. The plateau is dependence that every earlier frame shares with the segment, which the nearest frames already carry. The pairwise estimate therefore predicts that greater memory depth keeps quality the same while requiring more steps. Table 28 reports the 4 VBench dimensions we declared before decoding. In subject consistency, every other setting lies below the shipped one, within 2 paired standard errors. We decode with the synchronised schedule and causal blocks of 1 frame, so that each segment conditions on exactly the frames its row states, and every frame is denoised before the rollout is scored. With blocks of 5 frames the released code truncates each segment’s prefix to whole blocks, and the 5-, 25- and 33-frame depths would condition on 0, 17 and 17 frames. We compute the step count directly from the schedule and score the entire rollout so that the evaluation includes discontinuities between segments, which separate scoring of each segment would miss. On every dimension, every setting scores at most 2 paired standard errors above the shipped one, and 2 cells score more than 2 below it: background consistency at 57 frames and imaging quality at 25 frames.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还使用核函数比较已发布的视频权重上的调度方案。 Diffusion Forcing 系列的一个检查点支持每帧独立的层级，使得调度方案可以调整记忆深度：即每个片段所依赖的先前帧的数量（Chen et al., 2024；Chen et al., 2025）。 在解码之前，我们估算这些权重上帧之间的核函数。 在 6 个潜在帧内，相邻帧之间的该值会降至其原始值的约 60%，而超过此范围后变化很小；相比之下，图 4 中的标记核函数在距离达到 16 时已降至接近零。 这一平台期反映了每个先前帧与片段之间存在的依赖关系，而这种依赖最近的帧已经包含在内。 因此，成对估计预测：更大的记忆深度能保持质量不变，但需要更多步骤。 表 28 报告了我们在解码前声明的 4 个 VBench 维度。 在主体一致性方面，所有其他设置均低于已发布的设置，且差异在 2 个成对标准误差范围内。 我们使用同步调度方案和每帧为 1 个因果块进行解码，以确保每个片段仅基于其所在行指定的帧进行条件生成，并且每个帧在评估 rollout 之前完成去噪。 当使用 5 帧的块时，已发布的代码会将每个片段的上下文截断为完整的块；此时 5、25 和 33 帧的深度将分别基于 0、17 和 17 个帧进行条件生成。 我们直接从调度方案中计算步数，并对整个 rollout 进行评分，这样评估就能涵盖片段之间的不连续性——而单独为每个片段评分则会忽略这些不连续性。 在所有维度上，每种设置的评分最多比已发布的设置高 2 个成对标准误差，且有 2 个单元格的评分低于该值超过 2 个标准误差：分别是 57 帧时的背景一致性和 25 帧时的成像质量。
